title: Cyclic-group d-cube-free density bound
target: Let d and N be positive integers with d dividing N. In the additive cyclic group Z_N, for a size-d multiset S={a_1,...,a_d}, define its projective d-cube to be the set of all sums sum_{i in I} a_i over nonempty subsets I of {1,...,d}; repeated a_i and zero entries are allowed. Call A subseteq Z_N d-cube-free when no such projective d-cube is contained in A. Prove that every d-cube-free A satisfies |A|<=((d-1)/d)N. Alternatively, disprove the statement by giving explicit admissible d,N,A with |A|>((d-1)/d)N and rigorously proving that A is d-cube-free against all size-d multisets, including those with repetitions or zeros.

extracted_text.tool: Manual transcription checked against the retained publisher PDF; line wrapping and mathematical glyph presentation normalized.

locators.label: Projective d-cube and d-cube-free
locators.excerpt:
Definition 1. Given a multiset S = {a_1,...,a_d} of size d, we define the
projective d-cube generated by S as

  Σ* S = { sum_{i in I} a_i : emptyset != I subseteq [d] }.

Definition 2. We say A is d-cube-free if there does not exist a multiset S of
size d with (Σ* S) subseteq A.

locators.label: Conjecture 4
locators.excerpt:
Conjecture 4. Let A be a d-cube-free subset of Z_N where d | N, then

  |A| <= ((d-1)/d) N.

caveats: The proved d=3, smallest-prime-factor, and prime-power cases do not settle all composite pairs d|N.
Reports about the paper's separate diagonal Conjecture 10 do not resolve Conjecture 4.
